result.claim_text: On five Hilti 2022 recordings on which no camera-IMU estimate had been made, Calibrex's targetless camera-IMU rotation for the two forward Alphasense cameras (cam0, cam1) gives honest per-axis verdicts against Hilti's Kalibr calibration: every rotation axis it judges (reported std at most 0.3 deg and its 1 deg known-bad control detected on held-out windows) is within 1.0 deg, every clock offset it judges within 0.75 ms; it judges at least half of the axes; an axis judged on several recordings spans at most 1.0 deg; and an axis judged for both cameras reproduces Kalibr's cam0-to-cam1 rotation within 0.75 deg.
result.summary: Every frozen required gate and declared dataset/rig coverage criterion is achieved.

result.claim_text: On twelve Hilti 2022 recordings not used in development, Calibrex's targetless camera-camera check reproduces Kalibr's rotation of five camera pairs within 0.75 deg on every judged axis, scores at least 70 percent of them, flags a 1 deg turn of a forward or a side camera in at least 90 percent of evaluable trials, and names the turned camera in at least half.
result.summary: At least one frozen required numerical or integrity gate is contradicted; the declared SOTA claim is not supported.

result.claim_text: On five Hilti 2022 recordings of at least 200 s not used to develop the method, Calibrex's targetless camera-IMU rotation for the two forward cameras agrees with Kalibr within 1.0 deg and 0.5 ms, is constrained on all three axes, reproduces across recordings within 0.75 deg, and reproduces Kalibr's cam0-to-cam1 rotation within 0.5 deg.
result.summary: At least one frozen required numerical or integrity gate is contradicted; the declared SOTA claim is not supported.

result.claim_text: On four Hilti 2022 recordings not used to develop the method, Calibrex's targetless camera-IMU rotation for the two forward cameras agrees with Kalibr within 1.0 deg and 0.5 ms, is constrained on all three axes, reproduces across recordings within 0.75 deg, and reproduces Kalibr's cam0-to-cam1 rotation within 0.5 deg.
result.summary: At least one frozen required numerical or integrity gate is contradicted; the declared SOTA claim is not supported.

result.claim_text: On the four pre-registered KITTI raw and Boreas recording windows not previously read by Calibrex INS-LiDAR methods, LiDAR-only odometry followed by the default native joint trajectory hand-eye fit produces a scorable rotation estimate for every recording; every data-estimated rotation axis is within 0.5 deg of its dataset-provided reference calibration; at least half of the three rotation axes per recording are observed on average in each dataset family; and every observed-axis 1 deg held-out control is detected with delta chi-square at least 9. Dataset calibrations are reference estimates, not independent metrology. No translation, full-extrinsic or absolute clock-accuracy claim is made.
result.summary: At least one frozen required numerical or integrity gate is contradicted; the declared SOTA claim is not supported.

result.claim_text: On 23 KITTI raw 2011_09_26 drives that no Calibrex camera-LiDAR method had read, calibrex check --pairs camera-lidar gives honest per-axis verdicts against KITTI's calibration (calib_velo_to_cam with the rectification of calib_cam_to_cam): it never flags that calibration (no warn or fail); every rotation axis it judges there (reported std at most 0.5 deg and its 2 deg known-bad control detected on held-out frames) is within 0.75 deg of it, and it judges at least half of the axes; started at that calibration with the camera turned 1 or 3 deg about one of its axes, every axis it judges is within 1.5 deg of KITTI's calibration; it flags a 3 deg turn about an axis it judged on the drive in at least 90 percent of the trials and never judges such a turned axis right; and it flags a 1 deg turn in at least 75 percent of the trials.
result.summary: At least one frozen required numerical or integrity gate is contradicted; the declared SOTA claim is not supported.

result.claim_text: On 18 KITTI raw drives of 2011_09_28, 2011_09_29, 2011_09_30 and 2011_10_03 that no Calibrex camera-LiDAR method had read, calibrex check --pairs camera-lidar on each drive's first 600 frames gives honest per-axis verdicts against that day's KITTI calibration (calib_velo_to_cam with the rectification of calib_cam_to_cam): it never flags that calibration (no warn or fail); every rotation axis it judges there (reported std at most 0.5 deg and its 2 deg known-bad control detected on held-out frames at t >= 2.5) is within 0.75 deg of it, and it judges at least 50 percent of the axes; started at that calibration with the camera turned 1 or 3 deg about one of its axes, every axis it judges is within 1.5 deg of the day's calibration; it flags a 3 deg turn about an axis it judged on the drive in at least 90 percent of the trials and never judges such a turned axis right; and it flags a 1 deg turn in at least 75 percent of the trials.
result.summary: At least one frozen required numerical or integrity gate is contradicted; the declared SOTA claim is not supported.

result.claim_text: On eight KITTI raw drives not used to develop the method, Calibrex's motion-only LiDAR-to-vehicle rotation fits held-out LiDAR motion at least as well as KITTI's calib_imu_to_velo, and its pitch and yaw agree with an independent vehicle frame from the OXTS body-frame velocities.
result.summary: Every frozen required gate and declared dataset/rig coverage criterion is achieved.
